title: AI Foundations
description: Working with an AI coding assistant safely: what it receives when you set it up, what you may share with it, how Agile user stories define what a change must do, how to check an AI-made change against evidence before it is merged, and a closing check across the course's shell, Git and AI basics.
sourceCoverageNotes: Source slice: F1 rows 4-5, F3 row 2 (shared) and F3 row 4.
F1 row 4 'Reading: AI assistant setup and rules of use' is split into ai-assistant-setup and ai-rules-of-use so each page stays focused.
F1 row 5 'Reading: how Agile teams work (Scrum, user stories)' is mapped here because its acceptance criteria are what checking-ai-changes checks AI-made changes against.
F3 row 2 is shared with git-foundations: checking-ai-changes covers only checking AI-made changes; PR mechanics and review comments belong to pull-requests-and-review.

F3 row 4 'Tooling module check' becomes the learner-facing formative page foundations-course-check, a topic and not an assessment; the calendar moduleCheck is the course blueprint assessments/tooling-module-check.
